description: This file defines classes and functions for handling keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input events in Firefox within the Playwright project. It includes implementations for sending input events via a session, converting input states to event parameters, and managing input interactions.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input handling, sending keydown, keyup, and text input events.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Handles mouse input events including move, down, up, wheel, and setting the page context.

methods.name: toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: toButtonNumber
methods.description: Converts a mouse button string to a numeric code.

methods.name: toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Sends a keydown event with modifiers and key description.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Sends a keyup event with key description.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the mouse to specified coordinates with button and modifier states.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Simulates mouse button press at specified coordinates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Simulates mouse button release at specified coordinates.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Associates a page context with the mouse input.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the touchscreen at specified coordinates.
